# Headlight lens restoration and clarity

> **[Unverified]** This page rests on a single community report. Cross-check before relying on it.

> Items marked **[Partial]** are only partly confirmed by the source and need more work. They stay in the review queue and are firmed up, corrected or removed as more sources come in.

## Summary

Remove headlight assemblies and surrounding trim, then perform extensive sanding for clarity. [t1482]

## Procedure

> **[Partial]** Needs more work: the verifier could confirm only part of this procedure (the steps marked [Partial], or whether the list is complete). Steps or precautions may be wrong or missing; read the source thread before relying on it. Later runs fill it in as more sources are found.

1. Remove the headlight assemblies from their mounting buckets.
2. [Partial] Take off the surrounding trim pieces to expose more lens surface.

_Procedure reported by [t1482]. Photos of this job are in the source: <https://www.xterranation.org/index.php?threads/diy-headlight-restoration-no-more-cataracts.9787/>_

## Parts

- Sylvania Headlight Restoration Kit [t1482]

## Tips & gotchas

- Perform extensive sanding on the lens surface. [t1482]
- [Partial] Remove trim to achieve a cleaner finish compared to doing it in place. [t1482]
